title: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined
provenance: community test report by alemolamg (highball-db#9), unverified by Highball
notes: Runs and plays well. Reported on an Apple M5 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.8.3, engine wine-10.0 (Sikarugir) r1, Steam, automatic graphics mode (DXMT). Stutter during the first combats eases after a few minutes (shader warm-up); sustained high GPU load, the Mac runs warm and loud; no crash or instability. The executable carries D3D12 references, so D3DMetal is worth trying if a future build regresses under DXMT.
